test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 10 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A can finish 50% of a work in 30 days. He works at it for 15 days and then B alone finishes the remaining work in 30 days. In how many days can A and B working together finish 25% of the whole work?
solution:
**Given:**

A completes 50% of work in = 30 days

A worked for = 15 days

B finished the remaining work in = 30 days.

**Concept Used:**

Efficiency = Total work/Time taken to complete the work

**Calculation:**

Time taken by A to complete the whole work = 30 × 2 = 60 days 

Portion of work A finishes in 15 days = 15/60 = 1/4
